reason: I already have my own bike and the old town is walkable, so I don't see why I'd pay for someone else's. Maybe if mine had a flat I'd do one ride, but I wouldn't sign up for this.
objection: I already own a bike, and with only 10 bikes in town I can't count on one being near me when I'd actually need it.
would_change_my_mind: If my own bike got stolen or broke for a while, I might pay per ride instead of fixing it right away.
